Method of Attack: Initial infection via malicious attachments (HTM, HTA, LNK) disguised as Microsoft Word or Excel documents
Execution of PowerShell scripts and malware download
Modification of Microsoft Office Word templates to spread malicious macros
Targeting browser cookies to hijack online accounts with two-factor authentication
Exfiltration of targeted documents within 30-50 minutes
Planting up to 120 malicious infected files per week to enable re-infection
Automatic infection of USB sticks inserted into compromised computers
Frequent changing of IP addresses of command and control servers to evade detection
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)
Systems using browsers with session cookies
USB storage devices connected to infected computers
Attack Vector: Phishing emails or messages via Telegram, WhatsApp, Signal, or other instant messaging apps
Execution of mshta.exe, wscript.exe, cscript.exe, and powershell.exe processes
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious attachments with extensions HTM, HTA, LNK
Modified Microsoft Office Word templates with malicious macros
Frequent IP address changes of command and control servers (3-6 times daily)
